title: Milo Yiannopoulos, Right-Wing Agitator, Deported Home to U.K.
summary: Mr. Yiannopoulos, an early supporter of President Trump and vocal supporter of mass deportations, was himself sent back to his home country, part of a long fall from right-wing grace.
